text:
**Best value for home backup under $1,000: ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400W panel kit** — listed at **$698**. It pairs a **1,024Wh LiFePO₄ battery** with an **1,800W inverter** and a **400W solar panel**, giving you more solar input than the 200W-panel kits I found at similar prices. [See the kit and offer](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit).

**Important:** the listing describes it as a **pre-order**, so check the ship date before buying. If you need a kit sooner, the [BLUETTI AC180 + 200W kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit) is listed at $729, though the source says availability is expected later.

Either is for **essential loads**, not whole-home backup: about 1kWh of storage is limited for big appliances or extended outages. For context, another roundup cautions that even larger sub-$1,000 units won’t run a whole house. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup); [Haynet](https://www.haynet.net/best-solar-generators-under-1000-dollars/))
